backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining user profiles, pets, videos, categories, and authorization with persistent storage and helper validation functions.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module defining old/new data schemas and logic structures used to upgrade stored user, pet, and video records.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features to related frontend files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing prewritten summaries of various frontend content, components, and AI modules.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining root theme variables and base styling for light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: Base HTML file that loads the React application through main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Defines the full application router structure with authenticated, admin, pets, health, and AI assistant routes.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminShell: Layout wrapper for admin pages with breadcrumbs, title, description, and content container.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminVideo: Manages video links by breed, pet type, or health topic with selection UI and edit/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/admin/BlobImageU: Uploads and previews images using ExternalBlob with validation, progress tracking, and clear functionality.
frontend/src/components/ai/behavior/Beha: Collects pet behavior inputs and displays an AI-generated health assessment with recommendations.
frontend/src/components/ai/breed/BreedId: Runs automated breed identification test cases and displays pass/fail results with details.
Uploads an image, optionally adds a hint, and runs breed identification with result display and reset.
frontend/src/components/ai/emergency/Eme: Multi-step pet symptom input flow that uses assessEmergency to generate an urgency result and recommended actions.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAdmi: Wrapper that checks authentication and admin role, showing loading or access-denied screens before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/auth/RequireAuth: Ensures user is authenticated, redirecting to login while storing return path and showing a loading state.
frontend/src/components/common/CatalogIm: Image component that swaps to a fallback source on load error with optional styling.
frontend/src/components/common/SectionCa: Card wrapper that displays an optional title/description and content section.
frontend/src/components/favorites/Favori: Button to toggle video favorites, handling auth, mutation calls, and UI feedback.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Overall page layout with navbar, footer, and central content area.
frontend/src/components/media/CatalogIma: Catalog image with built‑in fallback source and error handling for media content.
frontend/src/components/media/YouTubeEmb: Embeds YouTube videos with optional favorite button and fallback link when ID parsing fails.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Bread: Simple breadcrumb trail with links and separators starting from Home.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Foote: Footer displaying credits and a medical advice disclaimer.
frontend/src/components/navigation/Navba: Responsive navigation bar handling auth, role-based admin link, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/onboarding/Dashb: Form for adding a new pet, assembling structured pet data and submitting via mutation.
frontend/src/components/profile/Favorite: Displays and manages the user's saved favorite videos, including loading state, profile creation fallback, and removal actions.
frontend/src/components/profile/PetsMana: Handles adding, editing, and deleting pets within a user's profile, including photo uploads and form dialog management.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileE: Allows users to create or update their profile details and profile photo, with validation and loading handling.
frontend/src/components/profile/Vaccinat: Manages vaccination records for user pets, enabling adding vaccinations and marking them completed.
frontend/src/content/health/healthCatalo: Provides structured health categories and topics with descriptions, symptoms, care steps, and video links.
Defines a catalog of pet breeds with detailed descriptions, care info, health issues, and related videos.
frontend/src/content/pets/petsCatalog.ts: Defines pet catalog data structures and provides static categories and subcategories with pet care info and videos.
frontend/src/content/recommendations.ts: Provides rotating daily care tips and a static list of recommended pet-care videos.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdminVideos.ts: React Query hooks for fetching, adding, updating, and removing admin-managed video links via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useCallerRole.ts: Checks if the authenticated caller is an admin using the backend actor.
React Query hooks for managing pet categories and breeds through backend CRUD operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context, handling login, logout, stored identities, and AuthClient setup.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for managing user profiles, pets, vaccinations, favorites, and related backend interactions.
frontend/src/hooks/useVaccinationDueToda: Generates a live countdown until end of day for authenticated users using vaccination reminder utilities.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind base styles, color variables for light/dark and admin themes, and utility/component classes.
Scores pet behavior inputs to determine health concern levels and returns explanations and next steps.
Parses filenames and optional hints to score and identify likely pet breeds using token matching and breed metadata.
frontend/src/lib/ai/breedIdentificationT: Provides test cases for verifying breed identification logic using filenames and hints.
frontend/src/lib/ai/emergencyTriageRules: Assesses symptom severity to categorize veterinary urgency with recommended actions.
frontend/src/lib/vaccinationReminders.ts: Computes vaccination reminder messages and timing utilities based on due dates.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query and identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBreedsPage: Admin interface for creating, editing, and deleting pet breeds with images and video links.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCategories: Admin page to manage pet categories including details, images, and videos.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminLandingPag: Admin dashboard linking to management pages for categories, breeds, and video content.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminVideosPage: Admin tool for adding, editing, and organizing video links by breed, category, or health topic.
frontend/src/pages/ai/AIAssistantPage.ts: AI assistant hub offering emergency triage, health assessments, breed identification, and optional dev tools.
frontend/src/pages/auth/ForgotPasswordPa: Displays account recovery instructions using Internet Identity and links users to the external recovery page with navigation back to login.
frontend/src/pages/auth/LoginPage.tsx: Handles Internet Identity login, admin-specific messaging, error display, and redirects users after authentication.
frontend/src/pages/auth/SignupPage.tsx: Provides an Internet Identity–based signup flow with feature highlights and redirects authenticated users to the dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the user dashboard with pet data, reminders, onboarding, and loading/error states.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCareLand: Shows the main health categories with icons and links to detailed pages for grooming, nutrition, vaccination, and emergency care.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthCategory: Renders a selected health category with its description and a grid of topics linking to deeper content pages.
frontend/src/pages/health/HealthTopicPag: Displays detailed health topic content including symptoms, causes, prevention, care steps, emergency warnings, and videos from admin or static data.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page showing hero content, feature highlights, and calls to action based on authentication.
Shows detailed breed info from backend or static catalog, including description, image, temperament, and videos, with breadcrumb navigation and favorites support.
frontend/src/pages/pets/BreedListPage.ts: Lists breeds for a pet category using backend data when available, falling back to static catalog, and renders cards linking to breed detail pages.
Displays a pet category with description, optional image, breed-link button, and subcategories, preferring backend data over static.
frontend/src/pages/pets/PetDetailPage.ts: Shows detailed info for a specific pet including description, image, care list, videos, and quick facts from the static catalog.
Renders the landing page for pet categories, merging backend category data with four core static categories and displaying category cards.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Profile dashboard with tabbed sections for account details, pets, vaccinations, and favorites.
frontend/src/utils/catalogRouting.ts: Provides helpers for normalizing slugs and mapping between category names, slugs, and display names, plus match checks for categories and breeds.
frontend/src/utils/petTypeHelpers.ts: Converts PetType union values to and from strings, provides display names, and checks PetType equality.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters with session persistence and hash-routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with dark mode, content paths, extended color system using OKLCH variables, custom animations, shadows, and typography/container/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Defines project state, architecture notes, image requirements, known issues, and feature requests for a pet‑care web app with hierarchical content and AI assistant.
